Messages.Author: ramst...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Hello,

This came out from our play group at Ramstein. Based upon the exact
text on Palatial Estate :
"This equipment card represents a unique location. The cost for this
location is paid by a vampire; put this card on that vampire. The
vampire with this location gains 1 blood at the beginning of each of
your master phases. (Ignore excess blood.)"

If you have more than 1 Master Phase you gain 1 point of blood each
time.

Is this correct? Or does the card only give 1 blood per turn at the
begining of your Master Phase?

Michael Eichler

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: msa...@cc.jyu.fi
Messages.Body:
Quoth the ramst...@my-deja.com:

> If you have more than 1 Master Phase you gain 1 point of blood each
> time.

You have only one Master Phase each turn, which has nothing do with how
many Master Phase actions you can take.
